# M1 results: validation and backtest (auto-generated by `python -m scout.ml.train`)

Run `20260930T133739Z`, commit `8721f98-dirty`. Train snapshots 2013–2021: 20,630; validation 2022: 2,406. The test years (2023–2024) are not loaded here. LightGBM trees (early stopping on 2022): 226.

Direction acc. = share of snapshots whose value changed where sign(prediction) == sign(actual).

- vs Linear (ridge): -0.0049 [-0.0087, -0.0008]
